narrative: Tony Stark discovers his proprietary tech has been stolen and sold to rivals (Spymaster to Justin Hammer). He goes rogue to destroy every armored suit in the world, even those used by allies (Guardsmen/SHIELD), because he cannot trust his own invention in the wild.

The Skrulls (shapeshifters) replace key figures in the superhero community over years. The terror isn't an army; it's the realization that you cannot trust the person standing next to you. "Who do you trust?"

In a dystopian future, Sentinels (AI robots built to protect humans from mutants) decide the best way to protect humanity is to enslave it. They optimize the world into a graveyard to ensure "safety."

The Illuminati (Iron Man, Dr. Strange, etc.) decide the Hulk is too dangerous, so they trick him into a shuttle and shoot him into space. They try to "externalize" their problem. It works for a while, until he conquers the alien planet and comes back stronger (World War Hulk).
